queries_run: solar module spot price contract price trend 2026
First Solar channel inventory bookings backlog 2026

findings.claim: 中國太陽能電池庫存持續下降，產業重心轉向需求復甦與庫存去化，但模組價格在 8 月兩輪調漲後又回落
findings.excerpt: Cell Production Cuts Begin to Take Effect; Market Focus Shifts to Market Demand Recovery and Inventory Destocking

findings.claim: 美國模組價格因反傾銷/反補貼稅及 FEOC（受關注外國實體）規定收緊，2026 Q1 中位價來到 $0.28/W，較 2025 年初 $0.25/W 上升；PERC 模組價格 2025/11–2026/2 上漲 20%
findings.excerpt: median solar module pricing in the United States reached $0.28 per watt as the market adjusted to intensified trade enforcement and new Foreign Entity of Concern compliance requirements

findings.claim: 中國 TOPCon 模組出口基準價（CMM）2026 年 6 月底維持在 $0.113/W，Q4 2026 及 2027 年遠期交貨報價因下半年需求預期轉弱而下滑
findings.excerpt: The Chinese Module Marker (CMM) benchmark assessment for TOPCon modules FOB China held steady at $0.113/W with spot price indications ranging between $0.110/W and $0.117/W in late June 2026

findings.claim: First Solar 合約在手訂單（backlog）截至 2026/6/30 降至 45.1GW、約 $13.6B，較 2025 年底的 50.1GW 下降；當季出貨 7.6GW、新增訂單僅 2.8GW，取消訂單多於新單
findings.source: PV Tech / Investing.com（First Solar Q2 2026 財報）
findings.excerpt: First Solar's contracted backlog stood at 45.1 GW valued at approximately $13.6 billion as of June 30, 2026, down from 50.1 GW at year-end 2025

cyclical_inventory_price_position.note: 查無 FSLR 自家通路庫存（channel inventory）具體數字；以合約 backlog／訂單淨增減作為最接近的替代訊號。價格趨勢資料多為中國矽基模組（c-Si），FSLR 為 CdTe 薄膜、多走美國本土長約，與中國現貨價連動性較弱，僅供對照。
